pages.text: A horse-drawn broadcast spreader with a spinning disc.

$(thing)Load it$() by right-clicking with manure, compost, lime, wood ash, sulfur, bone meal or straw. The hopper holds 128 of one kind.$(br2)Hitch it like the plough, then $(thing)right-click it again from the saddle$() to open or close the hopper.
Pulled across a field, it spreads one dose on every block of a three-block swath, under growing crops too. Opening or closing it tells you what is left. Break it to get the load back.
